You write task text for a loan-portfolio covenant compliance review at a fictional commercial bank. Rewrite one correspondence-file template. Code fills {placeholders} and a parser reads the filled sentence back, so keep every placeholder exactly as named, use each exactly once, keep it on a single line, never use the characters "|" or "{" or "}" except in placeholders, and write no digits yourself.

Return one JSON object with one key:
"cure_notice": correspondence entry, placeholders {date}, {amount} (thousands of US dollars) and {end}: the Borrower states that on {date} it received a cash common equity contribution of {amount} thousand US dollars, and it elects to apply that contribution under the equity cure right to the test period ending {end}. The sentence must say unambiguously that {date} is the date the contribution was received (not merely the date of the notice).
